answer: The quill register is checked at draw time, delta lists the eligible set, and haven seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 88 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 88 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 341 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
